contexts.text: An appearance as of fire with smoke, such as is seen in conflagrations...
Like the heat from burnt ruins after a conflagration...
Such as appears in the air from conflagrations...
In some Hells there is an appearance as of the ruins of houses and cities after conflagrations.
In the Word, concupiscences are compared to fire, and the evils thence to a conflagration. AE 504:end.
